questions.prompt: How does Nim's default memory management (`--mm:arc` / `--mm:orc`) manage heap memory without stop-the-world GC pauses?

questions.prompt: When does `--mm:arc` suffice instead of `--mm:orc`?

options.text: When your data structures are acyclic (trees, seqs, strings, value objects), avoiding cycle-collector overhead completely
When you have cyclic `ref object` graphs
